TITLE: Report
loadError: The report could not be loaded
cancelText: The analysis stops at its next step. AI costs already incurred are not refunded.
deleteText: The report with all its findings and the action plan is deleted for good.

PROGRESS.title: Compliance analysis in progress
PROGRESS.queued: The analysis is queued — it starts when a worker is free.
PROGRESS.running: You can leave this page — the analysis keeps running and the results are saved.
PROGRESS.cancelRequested: Cancellation requested — the analysis stops at its next step.
PROGRESS.stepsHidden: The step progress is visible to the user who started the analysis.

FAILED.title: The analysis failed
FAILED.text: The analysis could not be completed. You can run it again.

CANCELLED.title: The analysis was cancelled
CANCELLED.text: The analysis was stopped before it finished. You can run it again.

SUMMARY.title: Executive summary
SUMMARY.toConfirmHint: Whether these acts apply depends on facts the company profile does not state, so their obligations were not assessed. Answer their questions — in a conversation with the assistant or by completing the profile — and run the analysis again.
SUMMARY.upcomingHint: These acts do not apply to the company yet. Their findings show readiness and are not part of the result above.
SUMMARY.internalNote: gaps between the company's policies and its procedures; not breaches of law
SUMMARY.citationsHint: The references the company's documents make to specific legal provisions, checked against the legal corpus.
SUMMARY.citationsHeadline: {problems} of {checked} references need correcting — they name the wrong provision or one that does not exist.
SUMMARY.citationsNone: No legal references to specific provisions were found in the company's documents.
SUMMARY.citationsNotRun: The citation audit was not run for this report.

PROVENANCE.title: Provenance
PROVENANCE.hint: Which prompt versions, models and legal act versions were used — so the result can be reproduced.

ACTS.upcomingHint: These acts start to apply to the company on the date shown. Their obligations were assessed as preparation, and their findings are counted apart from today's result.
ACTS.unconfirmedHint: Whether these acts apply depends on facts the company profile does not state, so their obligations were not assessed. Answer each act's questions in a conversation with the assistant, or complete the profile — the next analysis will assess these acts or leave them out.
ACTS.indirectHint: A directive binds Member States; its requirements reach the company through the Lithuanian acts that transpose it, which this report assesses.
ACTS.institutional: Acts that organise an authority or a procedure ({count})
ACTS.institutionalHint: These acts set out a supervisory authority's tasks, powers, sanctions or procedures. They reach the company through the authority's decisions or the company's own applications, so they were not assessed against the company's documents.
ACTS.chosen: Not binding — assessed by the company's choice
ACTS.chosenHint: These acts do not bind the company. The person who approved the list of acts took them in as good practice, so their findings show a distance from that practice, not a breach.
ACTS.leftOut: Applicable — left out by the person who approved the scope
ACTS.leftOutHint: These acts apply to the company, but the person who approved the list of acts left them out of this report. Their obligations were not assessed.
ACTS.scopeApprovedBy: The list of acts was approved by {name}, {date}
ACTS.scopeApprovedAt: The list of acts was approved {date}
ACTS.scopeUnattended: The report was run without a review of the list of acts
ACTS.notApplicable: Judged not applicable by the AI ({count})
ACTS.none: No applicable legal acts were found.

SCOPE.title: Approve the list of legal acts
SCOPE.text: The acts that apply have been decided. Review the list and approve it — the obligations are judged only after that.
SCOPE.notYetText: The findings, the action plan and the summary are produced once you approve the list of legal acts.
SCOPE.goodPractice: Will be assessed as good practice — this act does not bind the company
SCOPE.skipped: Applies, but will not be assessed in this report
SCOPE.toExtract: Will be read for the first time
SCOPE.priceTitle: Scope and price of the assessment
SCOPE.reading: Of which ~{extraction} is the one-time reading of acts (their obligations are extracted for the first time).
SCOPE.estimateFailed: The price could not be worked out
SCOPE.nothing: No act is switched on — there is nothing to assess.
SCOPE.approved: List of acts approved — the analysis continues
SCOPE.cancelText: The list of acts stays unapproved and the obligations are not judged. AI costs already incurred are not refunded.

FINDINGS.focused: Showing the findings of the action “{title}”
FINDINGS.groupInternal: Gaps between the company's policies and its procedures; not breaches of law
FINDINGS.quoteNotPlaced: This quote could not be found word for word in the document — check it against the document.
FINDINGS.ceiling: The ceiling the act provides, not a forecast.
FINDINGS.overriddenHint: The status was changed by a reviewer. AI assessment: {status}.
FINDINGS.unreviewedHint: This obligation was extracted by the AI and not yet approved by a person — weigh it with care.
FINDINGS.upcomingHint: This act does not apply to the company yet: the finding shows readiness, not a gap of today.
FINDINGS.openUnit: Open the provision in the corpus
FINDINGS.openPassage: Open the document at the cited passage
FINDINGS.external: Official text (opens in a new window)

CONSEQUENCE.benefit: times the benefit gained or loss avoided

MEASURES.withdrawal: withdrawal or suspension of the authorisation
MEASURES.restriction: restriction or suspension of an activity
MEASURES.cease: an order to end the breach
MEASURES.public_statement: a public statement on the breach
MEASURES.management_ban: removal of managers or a ban on management functions

CITATIONS.intro: Every reference the company's documents make to a specific legal provision, checked against the legal corpus: does the provision exist in the act's current version, and does it regulate what the document says. Problems come first.
CITATIONS.list: Legal references in the company's documents
CITATIONS.none: No legal references to specific provisions were found in the company's documents
CITATIONS.noneText: The documents cite no article, paragraph or point of a legal act — or no document has been uploaded.
CITATIONS.notRun: The citation audit was not run for this report
CITATIONS.notRunText: Reports produced before the audit existed did not check the legal references in the company's documents. Run the analysis again to check them.
CITATIONS.overlap: Judged by word overlap — the AI judge was unavailable when the report ran.
CITATIONS.notFound: {act} has no such provision in its current version.
CITATIONS.notInCorpus: The act is not in the legal corpus, so the reference could not be checked.

REVIEW.title: Review the finding
REVIEW.noteHint: Why the assessment was changed or confirmed — the report's readers and the export show it.
REVIEW.causeHint: Why the gap exists — written by the reviewer; the system never writes a cause.

PLAN.title: Action plan
PLAN.empty: The action plan is empty — no open obligations were found.

PROFILE.title: Company data at the time of the analysis
PROFILE.hint: The analysis ran on this snapshot — later profile changes do not alter the report.
PROFILE.ownRequirements: The company's own requirements were assessed too.

APPROVAL.title: Approve the report?
APPROVAL.text: By approving you state that you reviewed the findings and the action plan. Any later change to a finding withdraws this approval.
APPROVAL.registerNote: On sign-off the report's action plan goes into the company's action register, and earlier actions are checked against this report's findings.
APPROVAL.withdrawText: The report is treated as not approved again.

REGISTER.added: actions added to the action register: {count}
REGISTER.covered: left out, already under an action: {count}
REGISTER.unchanged: The action register did not change.

OUTDATED.title: Legal acts updated
OUTDATED.text: These legal acts were updated after the report was produced: {acts}. Consider running the analysis again.
